reported: 2026-11-20: the Focus Board control in bb's thread header (native pane) shows no menu and appears not to set Done
where: bb 0.50.1 desktop app (macOS), native split pane beside the board; the same host page in system Chrome is the measurement surface
surface: http://127.0.0.1:38886/projects/proj_9da9h742i7/threads/thr_cvvvkw6rjz, split layout with the Focus Board panel in pane-1
method: headless system Chrome (bb browser-automation, local backend) against the running bb server, which serves the plugin bundle the desktop app runs; the macOS desktop condition is the host's own declaration applied to the page-header content row (bb 0.50.1 app/dist/assets/index-BF2hhcfB.js, the xA utility and the OA(desktopInfo).platform === 'macos' gate: [transform:translateY(var(--bb-macos-chrome-control-y,calc(var(--bb-macos-traffic-light-center-y) - var(--bb-app-chrome-row-height)/2)))]). The desktop window itself was not driven.

stateA.condition: no transform on the header row (a browser window)
stateA.reads: the three entries sit under the trigger, top right of the thread pane

stateB.condition: the host's macOS declaration on the header row
stateB.reads: no menu: it mounts (aria-expanded true) at row-x 816.5 + 1096 = 1912.5, past the 1280px window

cause: The menu is position: fixed but was rendered inline inside the header, and a transformed ancestor is the containing block of fixed descendants. The row's 2px translate re-anchors the menu's viewport left to the row's left edge, so the trigger's click opened the menu off screen and a second click closed it: the control read as dead (no menu, no Done). Fixed by portaling MenuPopover's shell and backdrop to document.body (components/menu-popover.tsx), the shape the SDK asks for ('put anything taller in a portalled popover') and the host's own menus use.
after: Harness re-measure (real Chrome, the repo's vite harness, built bundle): the menu's parent element is BODY, and with the app root translated by -2px the menu stays under its trigger (x 16 both reads, y follows the trigger 78 to 76). jsdom pin: tests/thread-header-actions.test.tsx, 'keeps its popover out of the translated header row, and Done still runs from there'.
